canvaUrl.label: Canva design link
canvaUrl.description: Paste a public design view link, Smart embed link, iframe src URL, or canva.link short link. Publish a public embed in Canva first.

url.label: Web address
url.description: The public page to show. Use HTTPS; plain HTTP works only for private addresses when this installation allows it.

backgroundColor.label: Background color
backgroundColor.description: Shown behind the page while it loads.

options.last_success: Keep the last page that loaded

allowedHosts.label: Allowed hosts
allowedHosts.description: Exact host names the page may navigate to. The page's own host is always allowed. This limits top-level navigation, not every third-party resource.

customUserAgent.label: Custom user agent
customUserAgent.description: Leave blank for the Player's standard user agent. Overrides can break sites.

url.label: YouTube video or playlist URL
url.description: Tilecast detects whether this is a video or a playlist. No YouTube API key is required.

endSeconds.label: End at (seconds)
endSeconds.description: Leave blank to play to the end.

captionLanguage.label: Caption language
captionLanguage.description: A language code such as en or es. Leave blank for YouTube's default.
